full_prompt_en: A square experimental black-and-white photograph looks over a city street and riverfront toward a distant lattice tower. The sky across the upper half is a pale, fogged gray rather than a clean white, with irregular dark smudges and vertical light leaks running through it. Left of center, the narrow iron tower rises above a low band of roofs; its open lower arch and tapering outline remain visible despite the haze. A river or broad waterway opens on the right behind a dark near bank, while clusters of low buildings and street structures stretch toward the horizon. The viewpoint appears elevated over a roadway that descends from the center toward the bottom of the frame. Tiny human silhouettes stand along a brighter walkway in the middle distance, and darker traffic-like shapes gather along the road. A tall dark vertical strip cuts down from the top near the right side, like a shadow or damaged photographic overlay. Near the lower left, blown-out white patches flare across dark architecture; finer streaks and speckling carry down through the image. The bottom portion falls into heavy charcoal black, with only scattered small highlights and a faint figure-like shape near the edge. Diffuse daylight comes from the pale sky, but photographic overexposure creates the brightest areas and obscures details in several locations. Soft blur, grain, scratches, and uneven tonal exposure make the city feel both present and unstable. No text can be read. The overall composition joins a distant recognizable landmark to fractured foreground layers, using extreme black-to-white contrast and damaged photographic texture for a ghostly urban atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形实验性黑白摄影从高处俯看城市街道与河岸，视线通向远方的一座格构铁塔。上半部天空是蒙雾的浅灰色，而非干净的纯白，不规则的暗污痕和竖向漏光贯穿其间。中央偏左，细长的铁塔升起在低矮屋顶带之上；尽管隔着薄雾，下部镂空拱形和向上收窄的轮廓仍可辨认。右侧深色近岸之后展开一条河流或宽阔水道，低楼和街道设施成群延伸到地平线。视点似乎高于一条从中央下行至画面底部的道路。微小的人影站在中景较亮的步道旁，较深的车流般形状聚在路上。一条高大的深色竖带从右侧附近的上缘向下切入，像阴影或损坏的摄影叠影。左下附近，过曝的白色块在暗建筑前闪开；更细的条痕和斑点向下贯穿画面。底部沉入厚重的炭黑，只剩零星亮点和靠近画边的模糊人形。弥散的日光来自浅色天空，但摄影过曝制造出最亮的区域，并遮住若干位置的细节。柔焦、颗粒、划痕与不均匀曝光让城市既真实存在又显得不稳定。没有可读文字。整体构图将远处可辨认的地标接到碎裂的前景层次，以极端黑白对比和受损摄影肌理营造幽灵般的都市气氛。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome photographic treatment uses heavy grain, haze, blown highlights, and dark underexposure as active compositional material. Pale gray fields bleed into near-white flares, while dense charcoal sections swallow fine detail. Vertical streaks, scratches, and translucent bands interrupt the image as if several imperfect exposures were overlaid. Sharp structure survives only in selected small zones; elsewhere contours dissolve through fog, motion blur, and reflected light. The composition lets faint distant forms sit behind large, partly opaque foreground marks, creating depth without clean separation. Diffuse ambient illumination is punctuated by sudden bright leaks and abrupt black edges. The overall visual effect is archival, spectral, and restless, giving ordinary spatial forms an unstable physical presence.
style_prompt_zh: 这种单色摄影表现把厚重颗粒、雾霭、过曝高光和深暗欠曝当作主动的构图材料。浅灰色场渗向近白色眩光，密集的炭黑区域则吞没细节。竖向条痕、刮痕和半透明色带打断画面，仿佛数次不完整曝光叠在一起。清晰结构只留在选定的小范围内，别处轮廓经雾气、运动模糊和反射光而消散。构图让微弱的远方形态退到大型半不透明前景痕迹之后，不靠干净分界也形成纵深。弥散环境光被突然的明亮漏光和骤然出现的黑色边缘打断。整体视觉效果古旧、幽魅而躁动，让寻常空间形态呈现不稳定的实体感。
theme_en: A hazy black-and-white city vista with a distant iron tower
theme_zh: 远处铁塔映入朦胧黑白城市景观
name: Antony Cairns
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
